item.title: Trump isn't on the ballot, but swing-state voters still weigh MAGA
item.description: Pennsylvania voters say they are backing Democrats in the midterms to check Donald Trump, though some acknowledge distrust of the party.

item.title: Haley Stevens criticized by fellow Democrats for not explicitly backing El-Sayed
item.description: Haley Stevens, a former primary rival of Abdul El-Sayed, avoided a direct endorsement on CNN's "State of the Union," prompting progressive backlash online.

item.title: Judge rules Trump DOJ illegally fired James Comey's daughter, rejects Article II claim
item.description: The Trump Justice Department fired Maurene Comey without cause, but a federal judge found it violated the Civil Service Reform Act and ordered backpay.
